audit.why: Lane difficulty is stated (EVEN, 5.5/10) and the engage-vs-engage read (Headbutt as the metronome) is present in tldr/winCon.
Power spikes are covered: level 2 all-in, level 6 Nature's Grasp vs Unbreakable Will, first-item flip when his R comes online.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[N].side is 'Skill' on all seven rows in the full layer while content win[N] already reads Maokai/Maokai/Skill/Maokai/Maokai/Alistar/Alistar (matching packet.levelChart). The two layers disagree on who wins levels 1, 2, 4-5, 6, first item, and 2+ items. breakdown.cooldowns also names no real cooldown number, and misses that Alistar's Q/W both ground Maokai's Twisted Advance mid-dash (missingInteractions rule dash-denied) and that Trample's auto-reset is the pre-combo tell (rule autoreset-burst-tell).
audit.why: Riot kit confirms: Pulverize (Q, grounding flag) and Trample (E, grounding flag) both shut off dashes, so Twisted Advance (W) can be interrupted mid-flight. Trample also carries the autoReset flag — its stacking auto-attack is the wind-up before the stun lands, not the stun itself.
audit.corrected: Realign phases[N].side to the already-correct win[N] values and rewrite each why to match; fold the grounding and auto-reset-tell facts into breakdown.cooldowns with real numbers.

edits.before: Sapling the brush — the lane's hedges are yours now; trades start with a tree's consent.
edits.after: Bramble Smash and Sapling Toss out-range his melee combo — level 1 trades belong to the tree.

edits.before: W threat begins: the point-click root governs their carry's spacing.
edits.after: Twisted Advance threatens a gap-close root before he owns both Headbutt and Pulverize — the level-2 all-in is yours.

edits.before: Sustain the margins with passive heals and sapling chip — attrition is a tree's game.
edits.after: W-Q burst plus sapling chip still out-trades his cow poke through levels 4-5.

edits.before: Nature's Grasp online — the root wave starts fights from fog and ends dives in it.
edits.after: Nature's Grasp punishes his short walk-up and lands before Unbreakable Will comes online.

edits.before: First item: the roots chain and the saplings tax every brush.
edits.after: Unbreakable Will makes his W-Q flip unstoppable through your CC once Bulwark items land.

edits.before: Late Maokai is the engage forest: R the formation, W the carry, and Q whatever the roots deliver.
edits.after: R immunity and a double knockback let him out-peel and out-engage a lone Maokai in the late teamfight.

edits.before: - Alistar Headbutt: matchup-defining — The headbutt-pulverize combo starts every play — respect flash range while it is up. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your Q Bramble Smash answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Headbutt and Pulverize both run 14/13/12/11/10s — either one grounds Twisted Advance mid-dash, so don't W through his combo window. - Trample stacks off an auto-reset; the wind-up is your cue to step back, not the cast. - Spend the R on swing moments only.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Root whoever commits into your duo — Trample's stacking auto-reset is the tell, not the stun; step back on the wind-up and W the follow-through.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: Unbreakable Will clears CC and cuts damage for its duration — banking your R into an immune Alistar wastes the swing window you needed.

notes: Full-layer phases[N].side had all seven rows flattened to 'Skill' while content win[N] already carried the correct Maokai/Alistar split matching packet.levelChart — realigned side+why to the existing win[N] values (win[N] itself needed no edit since it was already correct). Fixed both lintFindings copy-paste-bleed bullets and the cooldowns-no-digit finding, folding in the two missingInteractions facts (Pulverize/Trample ground Twisted Advance; Trample's auto-reset is the pre-stun tell).
